reason: intentional divergence (decisions 65 and 106): an untyped MX callee receives each fallback attribute tag as a plain data value with `content`, while Marko 6 exposes a bare renderable through its attribute-tag record. The stock fixture intentionally keeps Marko's consumer shape; an MX callee can declare `AttrTag<{ as: "renderable" }>` when it wants that shape. A declared data-tag callee gets a positioned compile error for `<${x}/>`, while an untyped callee gets `MX: this value is a data attribute tag ({ ...attrs, content }); render its body with <${x.content}/>` from HTML's `renderDynamic` or the JSX hosts' `mxDynamic`.
